raw_text: EU DisinfoLab just dropped the Indian Chronicles sequel. Some observations from the OSINT perspective: 1) Many of the domains were registered via Pakistani hosting providers (NayaTel ASN). 2) Social media amplification patterns match ISPR digital operations playbook. 3) Fake NGOs at UNHRC had officers with Pakistani passport numbers in leaked databases. 4) Timeline correlates with Pakistan diplomatic pushes on Kashmir at UN sessions. 5) Some accounts amplifying this content were previously flagged in our Pakistan military IO tracking. This is industrial-scale influence operations.
